website-building.name: Website building
features: Service or product pages (each counts as one)

types: Redesign or rebuild of something existing
Add a feature to something existing

inputs.website-building: text and image content, logo and brand identity, domain and hosting access, and one named decision-maker for approvals.
inputs.ui-ux-design: access to the current product, any user data you have, and test users.
inputs.business-model: access to sales and cost data (whatever exists), founders' time for conversations, and running the tests.
inputs.documentation: system and code access, key people's time, and one technical reviewer.
inputs.penetration-testing: a test environment or permission to test production, test accounts for each role, one technical contact, and the three signed documents.
inputs.marketing-content: access to the product and the people who know it, quick approval of drafts, and analytics access if you have it.

strings.empty: You have not selected anything yet. Choose a service to build the brief.
strings.title: Scoped brief
strings.noRisk: No specific risk shows in your answers.
strings.nextText: a scoping conversation, then a written fixed-scope proposal.
strings.disclaimer: This is a scoped brief, not a quote and not a delivery-date promise.
strings.fixedScope: No S/M/L band: penetration testing gets a fixed-scope proposal after the scoping conversation only; one retest of the reported findings is included.
strings.serviceTbd: Service: to be decided in the scoping conversation.
strings.riskContent: Content is not ready; this is the most common cause of delay. Set a date for it, or add writing to the scope.
strings.riskPartly: Part of the content is not ready; the scope will say which part and by when.
strings.riskDate: You have a fixed date ({date}). If the scope and the date do not fit together, the scoping conversation will say what can move to after launch.
strings.riskIntegrations: Three or more integrations; each third-party service has its own rules and setup time.
strings.riskPentest: Penetration testing gets its own fixed-scope proposal, and a written scope, signed authorisation and an NDA are required before any testing.
strings.riskSecurity: Security needs are not clear yet; the security self-check can be a starting point.
strings.serviceFinderHint: The service finder on the Services page can help you choose.
strings.copyFailed: Copy did not work. Select the text and copy it manually.
strings.sendBrief: Send this brief from the contact page

bandNote: The band is a starting estimate; the scoping conversation may move it.
roughNote: A band is the rough size of the work, not a price and not a duration. A fixed price is set only after a scoping conversation, in a written proposal.
responseLine: We reply within one working day.
